newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria Oct forex reserves rose to $540.8 mln.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria Oct forex reserves rose to $540.8 mln.

text.p: The Bulgarian National Bank (BNB) said in a statement its foreign exchange reserves stood at $540.8 million on October 31, up from $506 million in September.

The BNB slightly boosted its dwindling reserves through dollar purchases on the local interbank forex market to cover debt payments on loans to the World Bank and the International Monetary Fund (IMF), said a BNB official.

Increasing forex reserves is part of Bulgaria's pledges to the IMF in line with a tough reform programme sealed four months ago under which Bulgaria stands to receive some $580 million over 20 months.
An IMF mission is currently in Sofia to evaluate the government's reform performance after twice postponing a $115 million tranche so far.
